overview.headline: Quicksort partitions around a pivot and recursively sorts with efficient typical time

keyPoints.point: Students learn quicksort partitions remaining elements around a chosen pivot and recursively sorts the resulting partitions.
keyPoints.quote: partition the remaining elements into those greater than and less than this pivot, and recursively sort the partitions.

keyPoints.point: Students see quicksort has worst case quadratic running time but is typically much faster with logarithmic linear bounds.
keyPoints.quote: Quicksort has running time Θ(n²) in the worst case, but it is typically O(n log n).

keyPoints.point: Students understand many variants differ in how to select the pivot, partition the array, and handle small partitions.
keyPoints.quote: to select the pivot, to partition the array, to stop the recursion or switch to another algorithm for small partitions

keyPoints.point: Students learn using a selection routine to pick good pivots can give a variant with improved worst case running time.
keyPoints.quote: Select can be used to always pick good pivots, thus giving a variant with O(n log n) worst-case running time.

keyTerms.gloss: element from the array used to divide remaining elements into groups
keyTerms.quote: Pick an element from the array (the pivot), partition the remaining elements into those greater than and less than this pivot

keyTerms.gloss: process that divides remaining elements into groups greater and less than the pivot for sorting
keyTerms.quote: partition the remaining elements into those greater than and less than this pivot, and recursively sort the partitions.

keyTerms.gloss: repeated use of same sorting method to handle each partition until small groups are sorted
keyTerms.quote: to select the pivot, to partition the array, to stop the recursion or switch to another algorithm for small partitions

keyTerms.gloss: alternative version that picks good pivots to improve worst case running time
keyTerms.quote: Select can be used to always pick good pivots, thus giving a variant with O(n log n) worst-case running time.

keyTerms.gloss: sorting method with worst case quadratic running time that is typically logarithmic linear
keyTerms.quote: Quicksort has running time Θ(n²) in the worst case, but it is typically O(n log n).
